description: Alteration to the ground floor including the subdivision of the existing space, enhancements to the existing elevations, a proposed new access core and roof extension.
decision_conditions: <p>Prior to occupation a management plan for the proposed cafe use shall be provided to the council for approval including opening hours.</p><p>REASON: To protect neighbouring amenity in relation to the proposed new uses/entrances on the site.</p>

<p>The proposed development shall adhere to the recommendations and measures laid out within the NRG ZERO TM52 Overheating Assessment and the NRG Energy Statement.&nbsp;</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the proposal would reduce pollution, energy and carbon emissions.</p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved a minimum of two Swift nesting bricks and/or boxes shall be provided at or close to eaves level of the development hereby approved. The bricks/boxes shall be retained thereafter in perpetuity.<br><br> REASON: in the interests of biodiversity.</p>

<p>The approved development will be built in accordance with the Planning Fire Statement Doc Ref:&nbsp;LPM-71FS-BRE-001 and individual Personal Emergency Evacuation Plans (PEEPs) will be prepared for known building users requiring assistance, and a General Emergency Evacuation Plan (GEEP) will be maintained by building management in perpetuity.</p><p>REASON: To ensure safe egress of people from the building in the case of a fire.</p>

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

In the event that a variation is proposed from the works hereby approved, as a result of discussions with Building Control and the requirement to meet Building Regulations, full details of the variations to the works shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing, before the relevant part of the work commences on site. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.


REASON: To ensure that special regard is paid to protecting the special architectural and historic interest and integrity of the building

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.656;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span>﻿</span><span style="font-size: 12px;">﻿</span><span style="font-size: 12px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">Prior to commencement of the development, a scheme of sound insulation measures shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Council, of an enhanced sound insulation value of at least DnT,w+Ctr 55dB. Approved details shall be implemented prior to occupation of the development and thereafter be permanently retained.</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">﻿</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.656;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.656;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size: 12px; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">REASON: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site is not adversely affected </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; white-space: pre-wrap;">by noise from Class E uses.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.656;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">The developer is to install continuous noise and vibration monitoring systems at appropriate </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space: pre-wrap;">locations around the site to monitor and record noise and vibration levels during any demolition and </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space: pre-wrap;">construction phase. Data recorded should be kept for a minimum of 30 days and made available to</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.656;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">the Environmental Protection Team upon request.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.656;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.656;text-align: justify;background-color:#ffffff;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size: 11pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); background-color: transparent; font-weight: 400; font-variant: normal; text-decoration: none; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: pre-wrap;">Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site is not adversely affected </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space: pre-wrap;">by noise and vibration during development.</span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-cc82aed6-7fff-5035-ef09-8d6507ec2bb3"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#222222;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The rooftop planters shown on the approved drawing 'P0303-Proposed Elevation 03 (South)-F-24_07_26-DC' shall be installed and maintained in accordance with a detailed planting scheme. This scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the first use of the roof terrace. The planting scheme shall include details of plant species, sizes, and locations. The plant selection should be species rich and incorporate a mix of native and non-native species known to benefit local wildlife and suited to environmental conditions, along with a maintenance plan to ensure the long-term establishment, health, and success of the planting. The approved planting scheme shall be fully implemented and maintained thereafter in accordance with the approved maintenance plan.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-60f5eb19-7fff-91a2-9175-ad0fc71e9ce3"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#222222;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: To promote biodiversity on site through roof top planting, in line with Hackneys Local Plan LP33, policy LP46.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#222222;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">All trees and planting within the site shall be retained unless shown on the approved drawings as being removed. Any trees or planting indicated on the approved drawings which, within a period of five years from the date of planting, die, are removed or become seriously damaged, diseased or dying shall be replaced during the next planting season (October to March inclusive) with other trees or plants of a location, species and size to be first approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Any pruning works within the five year period shall be carried out in accordance with BS 3998:2010 (or any standard that reproduces or replaces this standard).</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-548bdc75-7fff-0b24-02a9-688679f3481f"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#222222;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: In the interests of biodiversity and visual amenity, having regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020).</span></p>

<p>Prior to occupation of the proposed roof extension all the remediation and repair works shown on the Heritage Drawings&nbsp;BW181-BW-ZZ-ZZ-DR-A-1301, BW181-BW-ZZ-ZZ-DR-A-1302, BW181-BW-ZZ-ZZ-DR-A-1303, BW181-BW-ZZ-ZZ-DR-A-1304&nbsp;provided must be completed.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the heritage benefits of the scheme are delivered and to protect the significance of the heritage asset.</p>
